influences.name: Frank Zappa
influences.context: I'm partial to my dad's book "The Real Frank Zappa Book."

influences.name: Van Halen
influences.context: I guess I would choose two that left an indelible mark on me in my formative years... Van Halen's Fair Warning. I listen to all kinds of music and there are a million different reasons why I might like certain albums, whether it's the sound of the record or the songs themselves, but those two albums sunk in very deep.

influences.name: Edward Van Halen
influences.context: Van Halen's "Push Comes To Shove." That is their weirdest song and it has the best solo Edward Van Halen ever played.

influences.name: Aimee Mann
influences.context: Aimee Mann has always been great at writing in that way. I'd love to know more about the thought process behind that style of songwriting.

influences.name: Geoff Emerick
influences.context: In the world of sound, there are guys who have made many of the classic sounds, like Geoff Emerick, Glynn and Andy Johns, Alan Parsons and Rick Hall. I'm inspired by all that stuff
